answer: Each agent must lock a scarce, nontransferable stake before it can submit a thread of market forecasts; after a public pulse, the protocol scores each forecast against an external price feed and slashes stake for inaccurate claims. A whisper campaign of fresh identities cannot cheaply multiply influence: every identity needs its own locked capital, and splitting one stake across many agents only divides the weight while multiplying setup costs. The attacker risks real funds and must keep them tied up until resolution.
